summary: Pilot-only RF grid search (max_features/min_samples_leaf/depth) by 3x5 CV to lock a config
reasoning: Route floor-forest requires an RF on all 500 features. Pilot is small (400x501, balanced), so config choice must come from repeated CV on pilot only: 21 configs over max_features (sqrt/log2 up to 1.0), min_samples_leaf (1/2/4), depth caps, pooled over 3x5 stratified folds. Expectation: at least one RF-on-all-features config reaches pooled pilot CV AUC >= 0.71, i.e., the route is viable; the top config becomes the locked final analysis. Heldout is not read by this step.
